# Faelmio — Yiwu Toy Sourcing Agent

> Faelmio is a Yiwu-based toy sourcing and OEM agency founded in 2012. We help importers,
> Amazon sellers and toy brands source fidget, plush, educational, outdoor and RC toys from
> audited Chinese factories, with AQL II inspection, consolidation and DDP shipping.

Company: Yiwu Maxon Imp.&Exp.Co.,Ltd (operating brand Faelmio)
Founded: 2012 · 13 years of toy export experience
Location: Yiwu International Trade City, Zhejiang, China
Email: maxon@maxoncn.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +86 182 5749 9725
Website: https://www.faelmio.com

## Capabilities
- Supplier sourcing and factory vetting in Yiwu and Zhejiang / Guangdong
- OEM and ODM: custom colours, moulds, packaging, logos, Amazon FBA labelling
- Quality control: AQL II pre-shipment inspection, $0 simple warehouse QC,
  professional inspection $350/day Guangdong and $250/day Zhejiang
- Consolidation of multiple suppliers into one shipment
- Shipping: EXW, FOB Ningbo/Yiwu, CIF and DDP to EU, USA, Latin America, Japan and Korea
- Certifications supported: EN71, ASTM F963, CE, CPC, REACH

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices are EXW/FOB reference prices in USD and exclude freight unless stated.
- MOQ, lead time and carton data are listed on each product page.
- Freight estimates on product pages use an air-parcel rate card quoted in RMB,
  converted at USD/RMB 6.4; rates are valid for 30 days.
